proof_roadmap: The system of triangles and its pushforward (proof lines 8780-8789).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S and a distinguished triangle K -> L -> M -> K[1] in D^b_Coh(O_X), the lemma asserts the existence of an inverse system of distinguished triangles K_n -> L_n -> M_n -> K_n[1] in D^b_Coh(O_Y) whose pro-systems represent Rf_!K, Rf_!L and Rf_!M (statement lines 8760-8774). The proof chooses a compactification j : X -> Xbar over Y with structure morphism fbar, applies Lemma labelled lemma-extension-by-zero-triangle to the open immersion j and the given triangle to get an inverse system of triangles on Xbar, and then pushes the system forward by R fbar_*, which by the very definition of Rf_! computes the three objects (proof lines 8776-8789). Producing the system by compactifying and pushing forward a system of triangles on the compactification is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
